name: seo-product-schema
summary: Audit product, offer, review, aggregate rating, availability, identifier, variant, and merchant schema facts.
inputs: approved product, pricing, availability, identifier, review, feed, template, and validator evidence
external_reads: approved page, validator, provider, catalog, feed, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live page, validator, provider, or catalog reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: schema, templates, CMS, code, feeds, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: product facts, schema properties, evidence, confidence, owners, and rechecks are explicit
no price, availability, review, rating, identifier, offer, or variant is invented
no rich-result, ranking, sales, traffic, or revenue guarantee is made
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated schema facts
verify no schema, template, CMS, code, feed, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
